text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
There was a rumor that my birthday was 
canceled this year, but I worked it out 
with a plea bargain! All of ya, celebrate 
to your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I am not so ill-mannered as to disregard a 
celebratory occasion. Rejoice, for I shall 
offer my congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Gold Ship-san. May this 
year bring you much happiness.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Orfe, Gentile... *sniff*, thanks, guys. 
To return the favor, I'll go ahead and 
redo your room's floors with tatami mats 
for ya."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Simply keep your gratitude for the King 
within your heart.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, knowing how sweet you guys are, I 
figured you might hold back otherwise.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I already sent it to your room. This 
year's brand-new tatami mat, 'THE 
Armageddon'!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Orfe gets shocking pink, and Gentil gets 
salmon pink♪ Ah, or would you two rather 
swap?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Color is not an issue. To begin with, I 
have no need for one.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The King commands you. Take it back 
immediately, Gold Ship.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I told ya, don't hold back! Besides... I 
don't need it anyway.
